video_title: KAT & Deuce McBride recap Knicks' championship run 🏆 | The Roommates Show

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on his confidence in the Timberwolves' playoff run
quotes.excerpt: I felt really confident in us after round one. I could see the vision.
quotes.quote: I felt really confident in us after round one. I could see the vision. I could see our team, how we looked at it, and we those last couple games in Atlanta, we looked the best version of ourselves. And I thought that when you look like that, you can't be this.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on respecting opponents despite their own team's struggles
quotes.excerpt: For us, we always give that respect. We always respect the game of the opponent.
quotes.quote: For us, we always give that respect. We always respect the game of the opponent because sometimes us not playing our best, it's because they came out with a level of intensity and they imposed their will on the game and they didn't allow us to play our best. And I feel like we did that, and they never gave it the credit, and it was like, okay, we're that just added fuel to the fire.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the Timberwolves' underdog mentality during the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: Every time we stepped on the court, it was always told that we were the underdogs.
quotes.quote: Every time we stepped on the court, it was always told that we were the underdogs. We were the prey. We were the people that couldn't get it done, and our locker room always thought we were the predators. We were the one coming out there to get the job done. And I always say, as long as these fans believe in us and our locker room believes in what we say, we don't worry about no noise outside.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the competitive challenge of facing Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: Everybody better than Jalen Brunson until it's time to be better than Jalen Brunson.
quotes.quote: I already know it's a true statement. Everybody better than Jalen Brunson until it's time to be better than Jalen Brunson. I had to make sure I was right there with him, and he did the job done. So I just wanted to make sure I go out there and utilize my experience, and I just remember that it brought up that same matchup like me versus Nikola Jokic in the Denver series, and I wanted to kind of bring that physicality and intensity to the game.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on his role and sacrifice for the Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: The offensive more so going to run through Jalen Brunson at certain point.
quotes.quote: The offensive more so going to run through Jalen Brunson at certain point, but then we went to you as the hub and you really dictated everything and getting Jalen Brunson involved, getting OG involved, and you sacrificed your own points, touches, shots. So one, I want to highlight you for that, but also two, I want you to talk about your mindset during that time because I feel like you're a big part of the reason why that playoff run changed when we were down 2-1.
